name: claude-plugins
title_zh: 一次装齐 11 件小工具的 Claude 插件包
tagline_zh: 懒得一个个挑 skill 的人，直接把这包塞进 Claude 就行：11 件各管一段活，从写代码到整理笔记都有。
tagline_en: Skip the one-by-one skill hunt: eleven small Claude skills in a single install, covering coding to note cleanup.
why_zh: 合集的价值在于覆盖面和一致性：11 件都按同一套写法组织，命名、触发条件、边界说明风格统一。
why_en: The value is breadth plus consistency: all eleven follow one authoring convention for naming, triggers, and boundaries, so.
limit_zh: 它是打包合集不是单点精品，11 件里你可能只用得上三四件；每件都偏轻量，遇到需要深度定制的场景会不够用。
limit_en: It's a bundle, not a curated single tool: you may only use three or four of the eleven, each is lightweight and won't handle deep customization, and.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Eleven small Claude skills in one plugin pack
